NPI Proposal Comparison

D3 WBB NPI Proposal Comparison

Season
QWB multiplier
QWB threshold
Top wins limit

Real system: multiplier 0.667, threshold 54.00, top 15 wins. Every scenario is precomputed.

Proposal 1: the selected multiplier, threshold, and top-wins limit. The at-large field and all seeds are compared against the real system using this run. Automatic qualifiers stay fixed; the same number of at-large slots is filled by scenario rank.

Proposal 2 (on top of proposal 1): the top 8 teams from the scenario ranks are re-ordered 1-8 by an NPI run with the same multiplier and threshold but only the top 10 wins guaranteed to count. Wins beyond the limit count only when their game NPI is at or above the team's own NPI. Seeds 9 and below keep the scenario order.

Total QWB: the sum of a team's quality-win bonuses, max(0, opponent NPI - threshold) * multiplier, over every win, using that run's final NPIs.

All ranks are pure NPI order, not committee seeds. Games after Selection Sunday are excluded from every run.

Raw data: reports/npi_proposal_<year>.csv (0.720 / 54.00 / 15 scenario) and reports/npi_proposal_scenarios_<year>.csv (every scenario, one row per team per scenario).
